title: Genetic Polymorphisms of Interleukin-1B and TNF-A and HBV-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma
brief_summary: By detecting polymorphisms of IL-1β and TNF-α,this study aims to find the effects of cytokine gene polymorphisms(and their interaction) on susceptibility and severity of HBV-related HCC.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HBsAg-positive patients

Exclusion Criteria:

* HBsAg-negative patients
